name: funcs_round
code:
import cmath
z = 1 + 1j
p = cmath.polar(cmath.sin(z))
print(round(p[0], 6))
print(round(p[1], 6))
q = cmath.polar(cmath.asin(z))
print(round(q[0], 6))
print(round(q[1], 6))
r = cmath.polar(cmath.sinh(z))
print(round(r[0], 6))
print(round(r[1], 6))
s = cmath.polar(cmath.asinh(z))
print(round(s[0], 6))
print(round(s[1], 6))
